fields.label: Project Description
fields.value: Vajram Essenza is a creation of passion for those who wish to get the most out of life. A dream project from the Vajram Group, Essenza, redefines value homes with functional, yet luxurious and contemporary, yet timeless 2 bedroom (1254-1319 sq.ft) and 3 bedroom (1607 – 1785 sq.ft.) apartments. Vajram Essenza reflects the spirit of the discerning few who have experienced the finest in the world and yearn to have a slice of it for their home.
